extracted.intended_audience: attorneys or former practitioners petitioning for reinstatement before the USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED)
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative review of a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO, including required affidavits, responses to OED inquiries, and other record material to show eligibility; decisions may limit scope of practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Ni filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is a supporting evidentiary requirement for a reinstatement petition; the affidavit forms part of the record considered by OED.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (timely filing and submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Angus F. Ni received on June 17, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petitioner must submit a Petition for Reinstatement to OED; the petition and its date of receipt form the procedural basis for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responses to Office of Enrollment and Discipline's written questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Ni’s responses to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline’s written questions were reviewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responding fully and promptly to OED written questions is part of the evidentiary record and is considered in the reinstatement determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other information in the record material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Other information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement was considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OED considers all record materials bearing on eligibility — not only the petition and affidavit but any additional documentation or information relevant to fitness to practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope/limitations of reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Reinstatement of Mr. Ni to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office in trademark and other non-patent matters is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement decisions may be limited in scope (e.g., to non-patent matters such as trademark practice); applicants should be aware that full restoration to all practice areas is not automatic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision rendered by OED Director after careful review
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition; the supporting Affidavit; Mr. Ni’s responses; and other information in the record, the Acting Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline determined that reinstatement is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Acting Director (or Director of OED) has authority to grant reinstatement based on a comprehensive review of submitted materials; demonstrating persuasive, relevant record evidence supports a favorable determination.
